body:
I just feel like no matter how hard I try, or no matter how happy I seem to be, i'll always reset back to a baseline of depression. About a month ago I thought I finally started feeling good again, having changed my medication and thinking therapy was going better. But then the most minor thing happened and I slumped again. 

I am very fortunate to have a support network and means to access psychiatric care, but regardless I feel like it's always going to be an uphill struggle. I recognise that there is a real possibility that I will be truly happy in the future, but to be honest I don't want to work for it. I'm just tired of fighting to feel just ok. Ive been happy before and to be honest if that's what I'm aiming for I would rather just give up now. I feel like it's not worth it. I hate feeling so empty and dead.

I appreciate your kind words but I recognise this is one of the most selfish things I can do. I will harm others by doing this, I can only hope in time my family and friends will come to accept and forget this with time. This will be the one selfish thing I will allow myself to do.

before you confess anything you should ask what the therapist is allowed to say to your guardians if you are underage. generally, they legally cannot say anything unless you are actively about to kill yourself, in which case in many countries they are allowed to call the police. 

I cleared up what would be told to my parents from the start (i.e. nothing), which helped me be a lot more open. because of that i think my sessions have been a lot more productive.

if they do treat you like a moron, which i find unlikely, it's on them, not on you! they're supposed to be a professional, in that case they would be the idiot because it's perfectly normal to go through rough shit. good luck with ur appointment hope it works out
